node.statement: The chart base is admissible: because s is the real scalar +1 or -1, conjugate linearity of dagger and J^dagger=J give (sJ)^dagger=sJ. Bilinearity of bold-dot and the exact-unit identity J bold-dot J=J give (sJ)^dagger bold-dot (sJ)=s^2 J=J and (sJ) bold-dot (sJ)=J, so sJ has the right inverse sJ and zero unitary defect. By def-approximate-unitary-space, sJ belongs to calU=calUbar_0, hence to calUbar_delta because delta>0.
